findings.summary: The cited leginfo.legislature.ca.gov page could not be fetched directly this session (persistent Cloudflare block), so the exact article-heading bracket text and the literal "(Amended by Stats. 2024, Ch. 25, Sec. 1. (AB 2397) Effective January 1, 2025.)" history-note string were not confirmed against a live or independent full-text copy character-for-character.
findings.evidence: Repeated curl and WebFetch attempts against https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=FAM&sectionNum=3910. returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare "Just a moment..." challenge page every time. A secondary search independently confirms the substance (LegiScan: "chaptered by the Secretary of State on June 26, 2024 as Chapter 25, Statutes of 2024... amends Section 3910 of the Family Code"), and california.public.law's current mirror (non-independent per project rules) shows the same (a)-(c) text described in the clause, but the precise history-note string itself was not matched against any fetched source.
findings.suggestedFix: n/a - recommend rechecking the exact history-note wording directly against leginfo once it is reachable, or against the chaptered bill text for AB 2397 (2024 Ch. 25).

findings.summary: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov (the cited URL) was unreachable this session; the quoted text of Educ. Code § 67456(a)(2)-(3) was confirmed only against california.public.law, which the project's own sourcing rules treat as a non-independent mirror of leginfo, not as corroboration.
findings.evidence: curl to https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=EDC&sectionNum=67456. returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) on every attempt. law.onecle.com has no page for this section (HTTP 404). california.public.law/codes/ca_educ_code_section_67456 reproduces subdivisions (a)(2) and (a)(3) in text that is word-for-word identical to both citations' quotes, and its "Source" line attributes the text to leginfo, "updated Aug. 31, 2021."
findings.suggestedFix: n/a - no drift found in the mirror actually checked; recommend a direct leginfo re-check when the site is reachable, or finding a second independent full-text publisher for Education Code § 67456.

findings.summary: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov (the cited URL) was unreachable this session; the quoted text of Health & Saf. Code § 17973(i)-(l) was confirmed only against california.public.law, a non-independent mirror of leginfo per the project's own sourcing rules, with no independent second publisher reachable for this section.
findings.evidence: curl to https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=17973. returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) on every attempt. law.onecle.com has no page for this section (HTTP 404, consistent with onecle's index not having been updated to include this 2018-enacted statute). california.public.law/codes/health_and_safety_code_section_17973 reproduces subdivisions (i)(1)-(3), (j)(1)-(4), (k) and (l) in text that is word-for-word identical to all four of the clause's quotes, labeled "(2025)" and sourced to leginfo.
findings.suggestedFix: n/a - no drift found in the mirror actually checked; recommend a direct leginfo re-check when reachable, or finding a second independent full-text publisher for this section.
